title: Frontier tech radar
brief: A forward-looking executive panorama of twelve frontier technologies, positioned as a strategy-house tech radar. A concentric-horizon SVG radar (Now / 1-3yr / 3-7yr / Horizon) plots each technology by maturity, sized by capital and attention, coloured by theme, with amber reserved for the fastest-moving 'act now' items. Per-technology cards cover the July-2026 state of the art, key players, the signal that changed in H1 2026, the enterprise 'so what', and the risk — across AI agents, humanoid robotics, quantum computing, gene editing & longevity, BCI, nuclear fusion, spatial computing, next-gen energy storage, synthetic biology and advanced materials. Closes on a three-speed synthesis and three board-level bets. Every dated claim web-grounded to current July-2026 sources with a full sources slide.
da: Luminous futurism — pale porcelain ground, graphite ink, one electric ultramarine accent with a single warm amber-signal for hottest items; Syne display + DM Mono figures; fine concentric graphite ringwork; radar-led, executive-clean.
